      description: production_date is required for Production Report extraction.
      rule:

        rules:

            field: production_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: production_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: production_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(production_date)) > 0
